print(f"  Data points: {len(high_temp_data)}")

plt.scatter(low_temp_data['Temp'], low_temp_data['Density'],

temp_range_low = np.linspace(low_temp_data['Temp'].min(), low_temp_data['Temp'].max(), 100)

plt.plot(temp_range_low, density_fit_low, 'b-', linewidth=2,

density_extended_low = slope_low * temp_extended + intercept_low

plt.plot(temp_extended, density_extended_low, 'b--', linewidth=1, alpha=0.3)

# Mark Tg

         markeredgecolor='black', label=f'Tg = {Tg:.2f} K')
plt.axvline(Tg, color='green', linestyle=':', linewidth=2, alpha=0.5)

plt.legend(fontsize=11, loc='best')
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('tg_determination.png', dpi=150)
plt.close()

print("\nDetailed plot saved as tg_determination.png")
